article.title: 更進新聞：Genie 4開放開發者API，支援即時控制互動場景
article.summary: Google公布Genie 4可經Gemini API的Interactions API及Google AI Studio接入，讓開發者建立互動世界原型。
highlights: 輸入可用文字、參考圖或兩者，生成720p、24fps畫面及同步音訊。
鍵盤與即時文字提示可控制環境，生成內容含SynthID浮水印。
article.why: 開發者入口讓互動概念由網頁探索走向自建原型，品牌體驗團隊可決定哪些控制需要接到自己的介面。
article.next_step: 先畫出一條使用者控制路徑，列出鍵盤操作與文字指令要改變的場景元素，再估算原型所需的接入及生成成本。
article.detail: Google把開發者接入用於互動體驗、空間設計等原型探索，並提供AI Studio的互動畫布及起步範例。團隊可以先把一個展示概念拆成移動、觀察及改變物件的操作，判斷模型提供的即時控制是否足夠，再按文件中的定價及限制規劃開發。這項公布是開發者接入更新。
article.title_en: Update: Genie 4 opens developer APIs for interactive scene control
article.summary_en: Google announced Genie 4 access through the Gemini Interactions API and AI Studio for interactive-world prototypes.
highlights_en: Text, a reference image or both can generate 720p worlds at 24fps with synchronized audio.
Keyboard controls and live text prompts steer scenes. Outputs carry SynthID watermarks.
article.why_en: Developer access lets experience teams assess which controls to connect to a custom prototype interface.
article.next_step_en: Map one user-control path and its scene changes before estimating integration and generation costs.
article.detail_en: Google provides an interactive canvas and starter apps for prototype exploration. Break a concept into movement, observation and object changes, then judge whether live controls fit. Review documented pricing and limits before development. This is the developer-access update.
article.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
article.followup: 11月20日版報道Ultra訂戶入口。這份API公告發布於11月19日，早於該期，補充開發者接入方式。
article.followup_en: Our November 20 issue covered Ultra subscriber access. This API announcement was published on November 19, before that issue, and adds the developer-access route.
